title: OpenAM before 16.1.4 fails to enforce PKCE in the OAuth 2.0 device authorization flow, never validating the code…
description: OpenAM versions prior to 16.1.4 do not enforce PKCE in the OAuth 2.0 device authorization flow, failing to validate the code verifier when exchanging device codes for tokens. This allows attackers who obtain an approved device code from client logs or shared device storage to redeem it for access and ID tokens, potentially impersonating the user.
